subject: Compact post-call recap + request: CTO/VP bridge to unblock pilot
messages:
From: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@starnet.io>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap from today + next step (CTO intro)

Hi Rafael —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side after the discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce inference costs for our real-time recommendations while keeping p95 latency < 120ms for peak traffic.
- Data constraints: customer PII must stay in our VPC; we need to clarify retention and audit log capabilities.
- Success metric for pilot: 30% reduction in per-token cost or equivalent throughput improvement at parity quality.

Next step we promised internally is a short intro between our CTO (Samir) and your VP/CTO-level engineer so they can validate architecture and unblock procurement. Can we schedule a 30–45 minute bridge next week? Samir is available Tue/Thu mornings PT but can flex slightly.

I attached a brief org chart and the prioritized use cases we walked through. Looking forward to next steps — if you can propose 2–3 slots I will confirm with Samir and procurement.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Gupta
Head of ML Platform
Starnet Logistics
(attachment: starnet-org-chart.pdf)
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@starnet.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap from today + next step (CTO intro)

Hi Aisha — great notes, thanks.

Very glad we captured the success metric and the PII constraint — both are straightforward but we should align on an architecture and a fallback/rollback plan up front. Proposed agenda for the CTO bridge (30–45m):
1) 10m: goals & constraints (you + Samir)
2) 15m: our proposed private deployment pattern (VPC connector, KMS, audit logs) + latency/cost tradeoffs
3) 10m: procurement/SLAs and next steps (procurement + engineering owners)

I can host and bring our VP/Tech Lead — Marissa will join for the deployment/ops portion. Proposed times (PT):
- Wed Jul 21, 09:30–10:15 AM
- Thu Jul 22, 10:00–10:45 AM
- Fri Jul 23, 08:30–09:15 AM

If none of those work, send a few windows that match Samir and I will prioritize. I pasted a short discovery notes PDF and our one-pager for internal infra to help prep.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123
(attachments: 20270720-discovery-notes.pdf, redwood-inference-one-pager.pdf)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Quick recap from today + next step (CTO intro)

Rafael — thanks, I’ll join the call. Couple of internal points to prep before the bridge:
- Karthik, please confirm whether we should present Dedicated or Private first given their PII requirement. My read: start with Private (VPC) with a fallback to Dedicated for predictable throughput during pilot.
- Prep note for the deck: include expected SLOs at different quantization levels and a short table of cost/unit at typical batch sizes. Keep it to one slide.
- If procurement will push for a shorter commitment, we can propose a 3-month pilot with an opt-in extension tied to measured per-token savings.

I’ll help run the architecture portion; Rafael, can you confirm whether we want our VP (technical strategy) or our head of product to join? I’d prefer VP/tech for CTO-level trust.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
